Marten._comment: Configured but DISABLED (DEC-017). Enable in Sprint-5+ for event sourcing.

Database._seed_comment: FRESH-BUILD defaults (2026-07-23): all seeders OFF. The deploy starts with only DefaultCoASeed + DefaultInventorySeed as reference data. Owner registers the first real user via /api/auth/register. To re-enable seeders for a demo/staging environment, flip the flags here + revert the Program.cs seeder block.
Database._resiliency_comment: Npgsql Resiliency baseline (DEC-093, 2026-07-24). Phase 6.3 hotfix (PR #149 follow-up): CommandTimeout 60→180 + ConnectionIdleLifetime 300→60. السبب: Supabase pgbouncer transaction-mode pool يغلق idle conns بعد 60-120s. Npgsql ما كان يكتشف الـ server-side close إلا عند أول read = 60s timeout ثم NpgsqlException. التقصير لـ 60s يخلّي الـ pool يتخلّص من connections المشكوك فيها قبل ما تستخدمها. الـ 180 timeout budget كافٍ لـ 3×180s + 6s backoff (retry في DefaultHoldingBootstrapHostedService).
Database._json_migration_comment: JsonMigrationEnabled=true (DEC-096, 2026-07-24): the JSON migrator (DataTypeMigrator) was OFF by default (Fresh Build Mode), but combined with NoOp C# migrations (DEC-080/082), this led to missing tables (accounts, vendor_bills, warehouses, etc.). Now enabled to ensure all JSON-defined tables are created on every startup. Idempotent (additive only).

Deployment._deployment_comment: Phase 6 — Multi-Company. DefaultHoldingName seeds the Holding Company row on first startup (idempotent). DefaultCurrency is the base currency assigned to the Holding if no override is supplied during register.

Authorization._authorization_comment: Sprint 63 (DEC-215): master switch for [RequirePermission] enforcement. true in production / mvp-docker. Set to false in test appsettings (Tests/ERPSystem.Tests/appsettings.Test.json) so the 50+ existing unit tests don't have to mock JWT/claims/IPermissionService for every controller. The attribute still runs in tests for RequirePermissionAttributeTests and AdminPermissionsControllerTests — those tests opt in by configuring IConfiguration with Authorization:Enabled=true.
